title: Agave Finance — ERC677 Callback Reentrancy Loan Drain Analysis
root_cause: Reentrancy via the `onTokenTransfer` callback of Gnosis Chain bridge tokens (ERC677), enabling additional borrows before the health factor is updated
other_code:

    │       Deposit WETH → Borrow LINK (health factor > 1)

    ├─[2] vm.warp(+1 hour): Time elapsed
    │       Interest accrues → health factor < 1
    │
    ├─[3] _flashWETH(): Execute flash loan
    │       Borrow ~2,728 WETH from Uniswap
    │
    ├─[4] liquidationCall(WETH, LINK, attacker, MAX, false)

    │       ↓
